name: OBLIQUE CRUNCH REACH
introduce:
Lie on your back, and bend your legs with your feet a little bit wider than your shoulders; place your hands behind your ears. 

Lift your shoulders off the floor, squeeze your abs and reach your right hand to the outside of your left knee. 

Return slowly, and repeat on the other side.

tips.text: Keep your hips on the floor.
Don\'t strain your neck or your upper back.
Exhale when you go up and inhale when you go down.
You should feel your obliques and abdominal muscles burning.
This exercise helps to strengthen rectus abdominis and oblique muscles.
